caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: This pie chart, titled “Distribution of Errors with GPT-4,” visually represents the breakdown of error types across a single run of GPT-4 on all tasks, as referenced in the paper Tur[k]ingBench. The chart is divided into five colored segments, each labeled with its corresponding error category and percentage share of the total. The largest segment, colored blue, represents “Incorrect” errors, accounting for 43.6% of the total. The second largest segment, colored red, represents “Correct” responses, making up 31.6%. A smaller yellow segment labeled “Partial” accounts for 11.3%. An orange segment labeled “Syntax Error” represents 2.3%. A green segment labeled “Unknown” accounts for 8.3%. The smallest segment, colored teal, is labeled “Bad Response” and represents 1.5%. Each segment is clearly labeled with its category name and percentage value, and the chart includes a white circular cutout in the center. The chart does not display axes or numerical scales as it is a proportional representation of categorical data.
